bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: The tile set-out starts with visible wall lines and the floor layout together, rather than treating each surface separately. We check niche positions, trim thickness and cuts around fittings against the selected tile format. A niche needs its prepared and protected base agreed before tiles are fixed; the tile finish does not establish that concealed junctions are watertight.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 排砖应一起考虑可见墙线和地面，而非各面独立。核对壁龛位置、收口厚度和装置周边切割与所选砖规格。固定瓷砖前，壁龛需确认已准备和防护的基层；饰面不能证明隐蔽交接防水完好。

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Retiling and access to the existing base
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 重新铺砖与现有基层检查

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Removing old tiles can expose damaged lining or disturb the membrane below. The written scope identifies the removal boundary and how unexpected findings will be handled before the new finish proceeds. Tell us which fittings remain, whether the shower is leaking and whether other rooms need to stay accessible. Plumbing changes and fitting relocation are agreed as separate trade work.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 拆旧砖可能暴露损坏墙衬或扰动下方膜层。新饰面施工前，书面范围明确拆除边界及意外发现处理。请说明保留装置、淋浴是否漏水及其他房间通行需求。管道改动和装置移位作为独立工种确认。

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Tell us whether you are replacing wall tiles, floor tiles or both, and which fittings remain. Tile choices and photos are optional for the first enquiry.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 说明更换墙砖、地砖或两者，以及保留装置。初次咨询无需先选砖或提供照片。

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: We check the exposed base, finished heights and membrane handover before installation.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 安装前检查裸露基层、完成面高度及膜层交接。

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Porcelain floors, ceramic walls and mosaic shower niches
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 瓷质地砖、陶瓷墙砖与淋浴壁龛马赛克

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: We lay porcelain floor tiles and ceramic or porcelain wall tiles in bathrooms and ensuites. We set out the room around the shower, vanity and niche so tile lines continue cleanly across adjoining surfaces. Large-format tiles need the base and cuts planned early; mosaic sheets need careful spacing at sheet edges and inside corners.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 我们为浴室与套卫铺设瓷质地砖，以及陶瓷或瓷质墙砖。围绕淋浴区、浴室柜与壁龛排版，让相邻表面的砖缝衔接整齐。大规格砖提前安排基层和切割；网片马赛克则细致处理片间砖缝与内角。

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: For shower tiling, we plan the tile format around falls to the floor waste, edge cuts and the waterproofing handover. Ceramic and glass mosaics have different backing and adhesive requirements. Bring your chosen tile or product details when discussing the room, and we can include preparation, set-out, grout and flexible junctions in the written quote.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 淋浴地面结合地漏坡向、边缘切砖与防水交接选择排版。陶瓷马赛克和玻璃马赛克的背衬与胶粘要求不同。沟通时带上所选砖或产品资料，我们会把基层、排砖、填缝和柔性接缝列入书面报价。

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Discuss your tile materials and installation →
Wet bathroom floors and easy-clean wall tiles
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 浴室湿态地砖与易清洁墙砖

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: We select the bathroom floor finish using the tile product’s wet-area slip information, the shower layout and the planned falls to the waste. Matt or textured porcelain may be worth comparing, but appearance alone does not confirm grip. Tile size, cuts at the waste, grout joints and cleaning access all affect the installation.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 我们结合产品湿区防滑资料、淋浴布局及通往地漏的排水坡度选择浴室地砖饰面。哑光或纹理瓷质砖可以纳入比较，但不能仅凭外观确认防滑表现。砖的规格、地漏处切割、砖缝及清洁便利性都会影响铺贴安排。

bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: For shower walls, we compare smooth glazed ceramic and porcelain with the intended cleaning routine. A surface that wipes clean easily can still show dried water or soap deposits. We plan the wall joints, mosaic niches and flexible corner seals together; the tiled finish does not replace the waterproofing behind it.
bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 淋浴墙面可结合日常清洁习惯，比较平滑釉面陶瓷墙砖与瓷质墙砖。容易擦洗的表面仍可能出现干水迹或皂垢。我们一起规划墙面砖缝、马赛克壁龛与转角弹性密封；瓷砖饰面不能代替后方防水层。
